turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You asked about the past simple with -ed, so let us look at it.
Example: Yesterday I walked home. Walk is the plain verb, and walked is the past.
Rule: To make the past of a regular verb, add -ed.
Right: He jumped over the box. Wrong: He jump over the box yesterday.
Now try a new one.
Write the past form: Yesterday my sister (wash) the car.
